The repository structure is now clear. I am checking Go files next.

The `CreateMemo` handler in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service.go` calls `DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook`. I still need to locate the delivery package and signing mechanism.

`DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook` is defined in `server/router/api/v1/memo_service_webhooks.go`. It calls `webhook.PostAsync(payload)` from the internal package `github.com/usememos/memos/internal/webhook`. The signing mechanism is HMAC-SHA256 with Standard Webhooks headers (`webhook-id`, `webhook-timestamp`, `webhook-signature`) prefixed by `v1,`.

The internal `webhook` package implements the delivery directly. It uses standard library crypto packages including `crypto/hmac`, `crypto/sha256`, and `encoding/base64`. No third-party webhook library is present.
